description: Tab hibernation, WebKit arm (bench_hibernation.py): hidden local pages with a stand-in heap (a port each, so no two share an origin), then hibernated; the phys_footprint each hibernated tab frees, the hidden pages' CPU and wakeups, and each wake's time to the page restored, usable and loaded, with the wakes that lost their scroll or form, light session. WebKit throttles hidden pages itself, so it has no frozen phase.
